name: Vic Fangio's Two-High Shell & Quarters Matching
description: The defensive philosophy that reshaped modern NFL game-planning. Built on a static, impenetrable two-high safety shell pre-snap that disguises split-field Cover 6 (Quarter-Quarter-Half), Palms Match Quarters (2-Read), Drop-8 simulated creeper pressures, and lethal boundary corner traps. Paired with light-box 5-1-5 Penny fronts that suffocate explosive passing concepts while matching underneath crossing routes.
